topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Rain's been coming down hard all day, matches the beat of the drum in my chest. Got a call from a teacher, a Miss Eldridge. Says she got a package, wrapped tight, no note inside. Comes from a kid, one of hers. Said kid's been gone for a while, out of touch. Could be nothing, could be something. Miss Eldridge, she's got a way of looking at you, like she's seen all the bad in the world and still expects more. She wants me to find out what's inside this sealed deal, why it matters now. Ain't that the way, the quiet ones always got the loudest goodbyes. I told her I'd take the case, but I ain't making promises. Not when the rain falls this heavy, and the streets gleam with more than just water.
